name: flywire_v783_central_complex_architecture_v2
description: Computational role mapping for the frozen FlyWire FAFB v783 central-complex topology. Roles are abstractions grounded in navigation literature and do not assign left/right semantics to DNa02 or DNa03 cell types.

scientific_controls.lateralization_rule: Only cell types explicitly defined by axonal projection are assigned left/right computational roles. DNa02 and DNa03 remain bilateral population types; later hemispheric copies must be represented explicitly if used.
scientific_controls.biological_function_claim: Roles are computational abstractions supported by navigation literature, not claims that the biological circuit implements financial risk concepts.
scientific_controls.topology_selection_bias: Financial performance must not alter the frozen biological topology.
scientific_controls.threshold_status: The 5-synapse extraction threshold is an operational reproducibility choice, not a universal biological cutoff.

evidence.citation: Mussells Pires et al., Nature 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-07006-3
